svg.title: $YARN total supply over 60 nights, three scenarios
svg.desc: Steady community: ends at 52,188 YARN, 3 missed nights, 0 resets; Slowly fading: ends at 22,390 YARN, 35 missed nights, 3 resets; Weekend dips: ends at 40,639 YARN, 17 missed nights, 1 resets.
svg.text: Good night: +10 YARN per tugger. Missed night: -1 alley life, 5% of treasury burned. 0 lives: streak resets.
